Successfully modified static_validator.py to: Create a new module with functions: validate_syntax(ast_tree) -> bool (using ast.parse or similar), check_type_consistency(ast_tree, symbol_table) -> bool (build a simple symbol table from the AST and verify variable/function usage matches definitions), and check_complexity(ast_tree, max_complexity=10) -> bool (compute cyclomatic complexity via control flow analysis). Successfully modified mutation_engine.py to: Import the static_validator module. Successfully modified reflection_parser.py to: Implement a ReflectionParser class that uses regex patterns and lightweight NLP heuristics to extract structured fields from raw reflection text. Self-reflection: The root limitation is not a missing capability but a failure to prioritize reliability over expansion. The system has built many sophisticated modules (meta-evaluation, failure analysis, reflection parsing) but hasn't yet used them to fix the core loop. The next evolutionary leap requires turning the tools inward: use reflection to heal the mutation engine, use failure analysis to kill unproductive goals, and use the orchestrator to enforce a 'hardening phase' after every N successful additions. True autonomy emerges not from adding more, but from making existing parts resilient and self-sustaining.

Successfully modified self_healing_retry_loop.py to: Create the main self-healing retry loop module. This module will: (1) intercept goal failures from the orchestrator, (2) invoke the failure analysis module to classify the failure, (3) call the reflection parser on the failure context, (4) generate 2-3 smaller sub-goals or alternative strategies based on the analysis, (5) enqueue them for retry with a different approach, (6) maintain a failure pattern log to track retry counts per goal type, and (7) enforce a 3-retry maximum per failure pattern to prevent infinite loops.

Successfully modified task_scheduler.py to: Add support for 'retry goals' as a new task type with priority boosting. Add a 'retry_count' field to task metadata and ensure the scheduler respects the 3-retry maximum by checking the failure pattern log before scheduling.
